q: He said, "Let the children play outside." (Make it indirect)
o: He proposed that the children could play outside.
He said that the children might play outside.
He told that the children can play outside.
He suggested that the children may play outside.

q: Change the given sentence from direct to indirect speech: Sayka said to her sister, "Will you go there?"
o: Sayqa asked her sister if she will go there.
Sayka told her sister if she will go there.
Sayqa asks her sister if she would go there.
Sayka asked her sister if she would go there.
e: Yes/No প্রশ্নবোধক বাক্যের indirect করতে reporting verb বদলে ask বা asked বসে, quotation চিহ্নের জায়গায় if বা whether আসে, এবং reported speech স্বাভাবিক বাক্যের ক্রমে লেখা হয়। Reporting verb অতীত হওয়ায় will বদলে would হয়। তাই Sayka asked her sister if she would go there শুদ্ধ। Told ব্যবহার করলে প্রশ্নের ভাব থাকে না।

q: He said to me, "I do not trust your words." (make it indirect)
o: He said to me that he did not trust your words.
He told me that he does not trust my words.
He told me that I did not trust his words.
He told me that he did not trust my words.

q: Apu said, “I am going to the market.” (Change into indirect speech)
o: Apu said that he had been going to the market.
Apu said that I am going to the market.
Apu said that I had been going to the market.
Apu said that he was going to the market.

q: She said to him, "Please help me with my homework." (make it indirect)
o: She requested him to help her with her homework.
She told him to help her with her homework.
She commanded him to help her with her homework.
She ordered him to help her with her homework.
e: Imperative বাক্যের indirect করতে reporting verb বদলে অনুরোধ হলে request, আদেশ হলে order বা command, উপদেশ হলে advise এবং অন্যথায় tell বসে, তারপর object ও to + মূল verb। এখানে Please থাকায় অনুরোধ বোঝায়, তাই requested। Person নিয়ম মেনে বদলায়। ফলে She requested him to help her with her homework শুদ্ধ।

q: Ygritte said, ''You know nothing, Jon Snow.' (Change the Narration.)
o: Ygritte said that you knew nothing.
Ygritte asked if Jon Snow knew something.
Ygritte said that Jon Snow knew nothing.
Ygritte said Jon Snow knew nothing.

q: He said, 'What a beautiful scenery it is!"
o: He wonder with joy that it was a beautiful scenery.
He exclaimed with joy that it was a beautiful scenery.
He said with joy that it was a very beautiful scenery.
He exclaimed with joy that it was a very beautiful scenery.

q: 'The prisoner confessed, "I killed him."' The indirect speech is—
o: The prisoner confessed that I killed him.
The prisoner confessed that he killed him.
The prisoner told that he killed him.
The prisoner confessed that he had killed him.
e:
Reporting Verb confessed Past Tense-এ আছে, তাই Reported Clause-এর Past Simple (killed) হয় Past Perfect (had killed)। Pronoun I হয় he। that দিয়ে clause জুড়তে হয়।
মনে রাখুন:
Past Tense-এর Reporting Verb-এর পর Past Simple বদলে Past Perfect হবেই (সার্বজনীন সত্য ছাড়া)।

q: Change the speech: He said to me, "Why did you leave early?"
o: He said to me that I had left early.
He enquired of me why I had left early.
He enquired of me whether I had left early.
He asked me why I left early.

q: Choose the correct indirect speech: The mother said to her son, "Don't go out."
o: The mother told her son to not go out.
The mother told her son not to go out.
The mother said her son that he did not go out.
The mother asked her son that he should not go out.
e:
Imperative Sentence-এর Negative রূপ (Don't + V1) Indirect করতে হলে told/ordered/advised বা forbade ব্যবহৃত হয় এবং ক্রিয়ার আগে not to বসে। তাই told her son not to go out। এই কাঠামোতে that বা should বসে না।
মনে রাখুন:
আরেকটি রূপ: forbade her son to go out।
উদাহরণ: He said to me, 'Don't wait' → He told me not to wait।

o: Rajib urged to me to go to the wedding together.
Rajib wanted to me that we should go to the wedding together.
Rajib proposed to me to come to the wedding together.
Rajib proposed to me that we should go to the wedding together.

q: Akash said 'I am sorry'. (Make it indirect)
o: Akash apologized.
Akash said to me I am sorry.
Akash make an apology.
Akash said that he is sorry.

q: The correct indirect form of 'The farmer will say, "I am busy." is -
o: The farmer will say that he is being busy.
The farmer would say that he was busy.
The farmer will say that he was busy.
The farmer will say that he is busy.

q: The teacher said to the students, “Thank you.” (Make it Indirect)
o: The teacher told the students thank you.
The teacher said thank you to the students.
The teacher thanked the students.
The teacher said to the students thank you.

q: He said to me, ‘I dare not go outside’. (Make it indirect)
o: He told that he dare not go outside.
He said to me that he dare not go outside.
He told me that he dared not go outside.
He told me that he had not dare go outside.

q: He said to me, “Friend, help me please.” (make it indirect)
o: Addressing me a friend, he requested me to help him.
He requested me as his friend to help him.
Addressing me as a friend, he requested me to help him.
Calling me a friend, he requested me to help him.

q: Choose the Indirect speech of the sentence: Karim said to me, "Where did you go Yesterday?"
o: Karim asked me where did I go yesterday.
Karim asked me where I had gone yesterday.
Karim asked me where did you go the previous day.
Karim asked me where I had gone the previous day.

q: Jhilmil said to him, "Thank you". (Make it indirect.)
o: Jhilmil told him to thank you.
Jhilmil thanked him.
Jhilmil said to him to thank you.
Jhilmil thanked you.
e: Thank you বলার বাক্যে indirect narration-এ quotation ও reporting verb said to বাদ যায়, তার জায়গায় thanked + যাকে বলা হলো সেই ব্যক্তি বসে। এখানে শ্রোতা him, তাই indirect রূপ Jhilmil thanked him। এ গঠনে you রাখার দরকার হয় না। Jhilmil thanked you বা told him to thank you অর্থ বিকৃত করে।

q: My friend said, “Long live friendship!” (Make it indirect)
o: My friend prayed that friendship might be lived long.
My friend wished that friendship might live long.
My friend prayed that friendship to be lived long.
My friend prayed that friendship may live long.

q: He said, "Alas! Inflation is rising rapidly with the ongoing dollar crisis."
o: He exclaimed with sorrow that inflation is rising rapidly with the ongoing dollar crisis.
He exclaimed with sorrow that inflation was rising rapidly with the ongoing dollar crisis.
He exclaimed with sorrow inflation was rising rapidly with ongoing crisis.
He exclaimed that inflation had been rising rapidly with ongoing dollar crisis.
e: Alas! জাতীয় exclamatory বাক্যের indirect করতে reporting verb বদলে exclaimed with sorrow (দুঃখ বোঝালে) বা with joy (আনন্দ বোঝালে) বসে, তারপর that এবং reported speech-এর subject। অতীত reporting verb থাকায় reported speech-এর tense-ও এক ধাপ পিছিয়ে যায়, তাই is rising হয় was rising। ফলে He exclaimed with sorrow that inflation was rising rapidly with the ongoing dollar crisis শুদ্ধ।
